criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Real renders and reliefs on a dark field, none at the showstopper descriptor. 1 jack near pure black. 3 left 60 percent empty, subject jammed right. 7 white rings, rack overhangs its stand, timber overshoot. 5 square rods, flat tag, empty band. 2 flat card, no curl, block clip. 8 flat orange bob and clip, dark tape. 4 corrugated bump. Strong: 6 and 9.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world and palette, accent on figure frames, value steady, camera move works. Crank motif and sky hue unapplied; the plan-view reliefs cut out of the spatial world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Numerals exemplary and checked against the art. The noun the deck is built on does not trace: c1 says artificial lift monitoring and no claim names the lift type, yet the cover says pump jack, the web edition defines artificial lift as the pump jack without a claim id, and the record title glosses it as pumps. Slide 7 puts a 2025 share in the present tense; the caption drops c28's attribution and adds 'already'; slide 9 sets the meeting against the question with no claim tying them.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What and who are clear by frame 2. Where is weak, no Texas county. The meeting is a standing meeting with no agenda item tied to this. The regulator contrast is the real stake and is stated well.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, turns at 3 and 8, the close an open question. 6 cuttable.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Specific and on register. 6's headline a spreadsheet sentence, 8's a fragment, the caption closer lacks an antecedent, the first comment printed a raw enum.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: First oil and gas topic in the window. lastLight again; the shut ranch gate close repeats nos. 54 and 62; dark plan-view reliefs echo no. 67.

hard_fails: An unverified fact presented as verified. The slide 1 headline 'The pump jack has a new watcher' (cite c1 c4) names the equipment the AI watches as a pump jack; c1 says only 'AI-powered artificial lift monitoring system' and no claim names a lift type. The same unsourced gloss appears in the web edition introduction ('Artificial lift is the pump jack and the equipment around it', no claim id) and in record tx-2026-0240's title ('the pumps that lift oil from its wells'). Repair: name what the source names on the cover, drop or source the web edition's definition, correct the record title, and mark the jack as drawn to illustrate.
one_sentence_fix: Rebuild the deck on the noun the filing uses, artificial lift, with the jack marked as drawn to illustrate, then give the jack on 1, 4 and 9 a real rim key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: About 60 percent below the dek empty; subject crammed right.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Orbit about 25 degrees left and lower the look-up so the horsehead and bridle fill the upper left behind the type and the rod sits in the centre third.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat white rings; the Texas rack overhangs its stand; timber overshoot.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera 0.5 m lower and yawed 20 degrees, worn tool-joint steel, timbers and stands trimmed to the rack width.
Warm rim key behind the jack at 10 to 15 degrees, kept off the ground; work light up and camera left.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Square rods, flat tag, empty band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Round bars and couplings with flats, lit brass tag on wire, rods scaled up and raised about 150 px at the same ratio.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat grey card, no curl, block clip.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A real curl casting on the steel, a wire clip, a tighter pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat orange bob and clip; dark tape.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Brass PBR bob and clip with a highlight; brighter tape edge.
Noise-driven bedding and fracture on strata_block.
